title: Roman Domination on Circular-Convex, Triad-Convex Bipartite Graphs and $P_4$-Tidy Graphs
summary: The Roman Domination Problem (RDP) on a graph \(G=(V,E)\) asks for a labeling function \(f:V\rightarrow\{0,1,2\}\) such that every vertex assigned value \(0\) is adjacent to a vertex assigned value \(2\). The objective is to minimize the total weight \(\sum_{v\in V} f(v)\); this minimum value is the Roman domination number of \(G\), denoted by \(γ_R(G)\). In this paper, we study RDP on graph classes motivated by convexity and induced-\(P_4\) structure.
